notes.title: The Steam Summer Sale is On! 🏖
notes.content:
STEAM SUMMER SALE
🌊🏖🌴Jump into some refreshingly cool savings during the Steam Summer Sale, like 70% off the adorable but challenging action-RPG, Gurumin: A Monstrous Adventure! This is the deepest discount Gurumin has ever seen on Steam, so don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity!

If shooters and warm tropical nights are more your thing, then things are really gonna' heat up when you see that the Heavy Fire + Reload Triple Pack is 75% off! 💥

https://store.steampowered.com/app/322290/Gurumin_A_Monstrous_Adventure/
 
https://store.steampowered.com/sub/80562/


NEW PUBLISHER PAGE
Check out the brand new Mastiff Publisher Page right here on Steam for all of the tasty deals going down right now through July 8.

And please be sure to follow us on Steam and on your favorite social media platforms for the latest news, deals, and giveaways! 😏🎁

PROTIP: Follow us on the the Mastiff Twitter account today for giveaways going down TODAY and TOMORROW!

NEW GAME ANNOUNCEMENT
We recently announced that we'll be working with MeNic Games to publish their toy city-builder Tinytopia! 🏗🏨🏙

The game is a 'toy-tal' blast to play! (That pun didn't really work, did it? Well, we tried. 😅)
Please check out the Tinytopia Steam store page and add it to your Wishlist today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/968550/Tinytopia/

notes.title: Lunar New Year Sale & Your Chance to WIN a $25 Gift Card!
notes.content:
Happy Lunar Near Year, everyone! :lunar2019wavingpig:

We hope that everyone has been having a wonderful year thus far, and that your holidays were filled with fun and cheer! 

We may be a little late to making this here sale announcement, but let's instead consider the sale news to be arriving fashionably late. Yeah, that sounds good...let's roll with that. 

Steam Lunar New Year Sale!
Aside from being able to pick up Reload for a steal-of-a-deal price (81% off), we also have a few other titles on sale too...like the on-rails action-shooter series, Heavy Fire. Right now both Heavy Fire: Shattered Spear and Heavy Fire: Afghanistan are on sale during the Lunar New Year Sale. The plucky action RPG, Gurumin is also on sale too! So, if you enjoy cheerful action-RPGs or arcade-style action shooters, definitely don't miss out on any of these titles while the sale is still live!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/322290/Gurumin_A_Monstrous_Adventure/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/305980/Heavy_Fire_Afghanistan/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/385600/Heavy_Fire_Shattered_Spear/

SAVE EVEN MORE BY PICKING UP THE HEAVY FIRE + RELOAD TRIPLE PACK!


https://store.steampowered.com/sub/80562/

Plus, during the Steam Lunar New Year Sale, qualifying purchases over $30.00 will receive an automatic discount of $5.00! How cool is that?! Thank you, Steam! :lunar2019smilingpig:

WIN A $25 AMAZON GIFT CARD!
Yup! We're giving our fans a chance to win a $25 Amazon gift card by participating in the Mastiff 2019 Customer Survey! Click the image below to start the survey and help us continue to deliver the best possible service and the best games at the best prices in 2019 and beyond!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7923016/bacd020db6c4fe47dcc6f3d286e8516a0a908521.png

We love to hear from you! So if you're on Facebook or Twitter, please don't hesitate to give us a shout. 

Well, that about wraps it up for now. 
Thank you for all of your support, and keep being awesome!

- Your pals at Mastiff :parin:

notes.title: Happy Holidays From Mastiff - Loads of Sales and Promotions!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7923016/f8d7d82894f69fdb8c5a6099fc0aca1543169bd1.png

- STEAM WINTER SALE -

Grab a cup of hot coco and cozy up in front of the warm glow of your screen because the Steam Winter Sale is live! 

From now through January 4 at 10:00am PST unwrap the holiday savings and pick up the critically-acclaimed action-RPG, Gurumin: A Monstrous Adventure and other action-packed titles from Mastiff like Heavy Fire: Shattered Spear, Heavy Fire: Afghanistan, and Reload.

You can also pick up all three shooters in the Heavy Fire + Reload Triple Pack at an even bigger discount!

You've been good all year long, so treat yourself, or send any of these games as a gift to those special people on your "nice" list!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/322290/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/385600/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/305980/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/330370/

Don't miss out! These jolly good prices are only valid up until January 2 at 10:00am PST!


- 3DS POCKET MONSTERS -

If you're looking for some RPG action on the go, join Parin and her monster pals in Gurumin 3D: A Monstrous Adventure, which will be on sale for 60% off on the Nintendo eShop on Nintendo 3DS™ across PAL-supported territories (EU) starting December 31 and running through January 14! You can purchase the game directly from your 3DS or by clicking HERE! 

Can't get enough Gurumin? Head over to the Theme Shop on your 3DS. There you'll find several Gurumin themes waiting to decorate your home screen. Each theme features unique art, game folders, and music straight from the game!


- IT'S PARTY TIME ON NINTENDO SWITCH -

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7923016/93d5b1e820ae5e05c938be501cdf0bdee6e660ca.png
For you Nintendo Switch owners out there, Mastiff also just released Party Planet, a compilation of 30 party-games for up to 4 players. It's the perfect gaming compliment to any holiday or New Year's Eve party, and it's fun for players of all ages and skill levels! Pick it up today from GameStop,
 EB Games, or from the Nintendo eShop on Nintendo Switch!


- PSN END-OF-YEAR-WAREHOUSE CLEARANCE SALE -

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7923016/a88e572344b0e249d70cf2da81db8130c5cf490f.jpg

If you're looking for some solid throwbacks, Mastiff's End-of-Year Warehouse Clearance Sale is currently underway on PSN! Act fast! Supplies are limited!

• Save 50% on La Pucelle: Tactics 
• Save 67% on Dirt Jockey


- JOIN THE MASTIFF ELITE -

...and don't miss a gaming beat! Join the newly launched Mastiff Newsletter to stay up to date on upcoming releases, sales, giveaways, and more!

Wishing you a Happy Holiday & a Happy New Year! We'll see you in 2018.
-Mastiff
